1339-1874-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-1874-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-4677-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-4677-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5233-5414-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Repeat.

4682-5140-6753-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-5140-6753-7824.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn and Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4682-5140-6753-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

1274-4659-5086-5183-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4659-5086-5183-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1322-2043-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
1322-2043-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1263-4871-5075-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-2279-3240-6462.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

662-1978-7488.description:
Cause Topiary Lecturer to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Topiary Lecturer.
Repeat from step 2.

703-2906-7012.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
703-2906-7012.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying at most {4}{U}{U} due to Rakdos.
When Astral Dragon enters, it triggers, creating two copies of Airbender Ascension that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Airbender Ascension tokens enter, they trigger, airbending Astral Dragon and up to one other creature.
Cast Astral Dragon from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat from step 2.
703-2906-7012.notes: The other Airbender Ascension trigger can be used to blink creatures you control. You would cast that creature in between step 3 and step 4, blinking it each iteration.

372-673-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-673-6991.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1330-1640-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Truefire Captain instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

2438-2736-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1385-2173-5073-5220.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2558-2981-4186-6701.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.
2558-2981-4186-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.

1323-4543-6628.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
1323-4543-6628.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using PuPu UFO's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Repeat.

2583-3921-5666-5870.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

578-3525-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-3525-5115.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least two artifact cards from your hand and add at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
814-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3356-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Polyraptor.
3356-5147.description:
Deal damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the damaged Polyraptor, dealing 1 damage to the remaining Polyraptor.
Repeat from step 2.

337-776-1329-4966.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-4966.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Chrome Mox to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Chrome Mox.
Cast Chrome Mox.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
